combo.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist, adding one mana.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, and its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter on it. Blood Artist also triggers regardless.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat

Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.

Resolve the Blood Artist ability, causing you to gain 1 life and causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting any opponent.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers when Forsaken Miner dies, and Forsaken Miner triggers when you commit the crime in step 1.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Forsaken Miner trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to Forsaken Miner's power.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Blood Artist triggers.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and gaining 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Ayara, targeting any other nontoken non-Human creature you control.
Ayara dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ayara enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability from step 1, putting a -1/-1 counter on the additional creature and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the additional creature, targeting Ayara.
The creature dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
If the creature was black, it enters the battlefield, triggering Ayara, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Ayara and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, drawing a card and then putting Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, gaining you 1 life for each spell you have cast this turn.
Repeat until your life total is 52 or greater.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

If Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it, activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 1 until there are two +1/+1 counters remaining on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from Triskelion, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 3 an additional time.
Triskelion dies.
Triskelion's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

roleTruth.rule: Conditional or delayed mana cannot satisfy competitive fast-mana evidence merely because Oracle text contains a mana ability.

comboTruth.rule: Independent win redundancy is the maximum supported set of pairwise-disjoint non-commander winning packages; overlapping variants sharing a required piece do not multiply redundancy.

readiness.caveat: This is a construction-readiness assessment, not a declaration that the deck is officially Bracket 5. A combo only satisfies the win-package gate when Commander Spellbook reports a win-oriented result; lifegain-only, value-only, and standalone infinite-mana engines do not qualify. Multiple winning variants that require the same non-commander card do not become independent redundancy, while genuinely pairwise-disjoint winning packages remain separate even if other bridge variants connect them. Fast-mana evidence is fail-closed against delayed and prerequisite-dependent mana. Bracket 5/cEDH also depends on competitive intent, metagame knowledge, pilot decisions, and tournament-minded play.
